name: bada-search
description: Bada Search — a PDF & source-code search engine that attaches to SourceTree on Windows 10/11 (launch it from a SourceTree custom action with the REPO parameter). Indexes programming-language sources and PDF text, and opens hits in the bundled BadaCineVim editor: Vim-style editing for sources, page view with highlight / pen / note annotations saved into the PDF.
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
